_about: How a character learns what a metal does (docs/blacksmithing-revamp-plan.md §9; the
API is docs/blacksmithing-contracts.md §6). Read by rules/knowledge.py, beside
content/rules/herb-lore.json, whose shape this mirrors so one module answers both.
Words, prices and times only: every number here is the rules' own, so no model ever
authors one, and every one can be tuned in play without a code change.
Prices are in copper (Core Rulebook Table 6-1). A smith's lesson is priced as a
healer's is: a skilled hireling's hour. The safe routes are meant to be the sensible
ones, and assaying a reactive metal the dangerous one (the owner's ruling, plan §2).

assay._sliver: The owner's ruling (plan §2): a sliver is a tenth of a bar, or one ore.
assay._comparison: Plan §9.2 (proposed, accepted with the plan): -1 DC for each other known material of the same kind, at most -4. Assaying is comparison against known references: touchstone needles of known fineness, spark charts (docs/blacksmithing-prior-art.md §3.8).
assay._danger_duration: A carrier effect lasts while carried and states no length of its own. Pathfinder #61 (via the sweep's §1.4 table): abysium's carrier is sickened while carrying it 'and for 1d4 hours after'. A sliver is put down when the assay ends, so the assay's danger is the after.

study._dc: 10 + 5 per rarity band, as herbs (herb-lore.json): the plan's 'DC by rarity, as study is' (§9.2).

teacher._works: Occupation ids (content/people/occupations.json) whose people know metals: the smith and the smith's apprentice, both of the forge. The words name the trade when no population record carries one. 'smith' alone never matches 'goldsmith' (the match needs a word boundary), so the metalworking smiths are listed by name.
teacher._teaches: Properties taught per lesson by attitude step (rules/attitude.py), the herb teacher's rows: below indifferent they refuse in words.

library._common: What the world writes down about metals: the benefits of common and uncommon ones. A rare metal's secrets and every drawback stay unwritten, as for herbs.

_working_words: A working trait's line on a card, until the effect vocabulary renders the type itself (rules/effectspec.py, lane A). Taken from plan §5.5's table: what the trait does at the bench, in words; the numbers are the bench's rules, not this file's.

working_words.easily_worked: each step takes half the time
working_words.pure: the Craft check is rolled twice, the better kept
working_words.slaggy: work from it cannot reach the best quality until it is folded
working_words.sulfurous: a wider heat band, but crude work turns hot-short
working_words.quench_sensitive: a narrow quench, and brine cracks it on a miss
working_words.reactive: dangerous to handle and to assay
working_words.cleans_slag: cleans slag out of a melt
